name: Assassin’s Mark
body:
School transmutation [evil]; Level antipaladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target a body slain by your own hand
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

When cast on a victim you have killed within the last round, the wound from your killing blow (or another of your choice) instantly reshapes into a mark, tattoo or symbol of your choice. It is automatically identified as your mark. When you first learn this spell, you select the mark it creates.

You cannot change the mark once chosen without extreme magical means (such as a wish or miracle).
